title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (Seed Cache)

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Web Services Read-Only Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web services interface of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct directory traversal attacks and read sensitive files.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Web Services Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web services interface of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct directory traversal attacks and delete sensitive files.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA Remote Code Execution and Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) VPN functionality of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or reload the affected system.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Web Services Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple vulnerabilities in the web services interface of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Remote Access VPN Unauthorized Access Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the remote access VPN feature of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct a brute force attack to identify valid user credentials.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Web Server Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the management and VPN web servers for Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Software Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the restore functionality of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system with root-level privileges.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA SNMP Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (EXTRABACON)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) code that is in Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a reload of the affected system or to remotely execute code.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Software AnyConnect SSL VPN Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the AnyConnect SSL VPN feature of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition on an affected device.

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Software Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the CLI of Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web UI feature of Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to create an account on an affected system with privilege level 15 access.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions or disable the HTTP Server feature on internet-facing systems.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web UI of Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software Simple Network Management Protocol Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple vulnerabilities in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to cause a buffer overflow condition resulting in remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software Smart Install Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the Smart Install feature of Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a reload of an affected device or execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the SSL-VPN feature that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
vulnerabilities.notes: Actively exploited in the wild. https://fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-24-015

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specifically crafted requests.
vulnerabilities.notes: Exploited in the wild against government entities. https://www.fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-22-398

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel in Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform operations on the administrative interface via specially crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software for specific PAN-OS versions and distinct feature configurations may enable an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based unauthenticated attacker to conduct reflected and amplified denial-of-service (DoS) attacks.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS SAML Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: When SAML authentication is enabled and the 'Validate Identity Provider Certificate' option is disabled in PAN-OS, an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability in the SAML authentication allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to access protected resources.
